secrets.name: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY
secrets.description: Emergent object storage API key — needed for photo/attachment uploads. Get it from the Emergent integrations dashboard. The app boots without it (seeded documents are served locally), but file uploads will fail until it is set.

secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.description: GitHub Personal Access Token with repo/issues read scope — create at github.com/settings/tokens. Needed for the GitHub page to pull issues and releases.

secrets.name: GITHUB_REPO
secrets.description: GitHub repository in 'owner/repo' format (e.g. myname/my-repo). The repo whose issues and releases are pulled into the app.
